The young forward composed himself before driving a low shot into the bottom left corner to make it 1-0. As the clock ticked down, the game became increasingly physical. Sam Smith was booked for simulation, and Will Lankshear also saw yellow for a mistimed challenge. Middlesbrough almost doubled their lead in the 87th minute when Morgan Whittaker led a lightning-fast break, only to see his shot cannon off the right-hand post. Ultimately, Middlesbrough held firm to secure a 1-0 victory and advance in the Carabao Cup . It was a performance defined by one clinical moment from Lankshear and a solid defensive display that weathered the late storm from the visitors.

On February 5, 2026 , two heavyweights of English football collided in a high-stakes Carabao Cup encounter. A Dream Start and VAR Drama The match ignited within the opening sixty seconds. Arsenal wasted no time establishing dominance as Riccardo Calafiori found the back of the net with a clinical left-footed finish, following a sharp assist from Myles Lewis-Skelly . The goal was briefly held in the balance during a tense VAR review, but the referee eventually pointed to the center spot, confirming the lead. Manchester City struggled to find their rhythm early on, evidenced by Phil Foden receiving a yellow card for unsportsmanlike conduct as frustrations began to simmer. As the first half progressed, the visitors' tactical discipline kept the hosts at bay. The City midfield, usually so dominant in possession, found itself crowded out by a hungry Arsenal press that refused to let the game settle into a predictable pattern. The drama intensified ten minutes later when Riccardo Calafiori was booked for diving in the penalty box—a controversial decision that denied Arsenal a chance for a third from the spot. Late in the first half, both ends of the pitch saw incredible defensive heroics. Martin Ødegaard saw a certain goal hacked off the line, only for Jeremy Doku to experience the same frustration at the other end moments later. These narrow escapes kept the scoreline at 2-0 heading into the interval, leaving the door slightly ajar for a potential comeback. Ødegaard Seals the Deal Any hopes of a Manchester City recovery were effectively extinguished just three minutes after the restart. Martin Ødegaard , who had been the architect of so much of his team's success, turned scorer by finishing with his left foot after excellent work from Tzolis and Lewis-Skelly . The 3-0 deficit prompted Pep Guardiola to make sweeping changes, including replacing Erling Haaland with Omar Marmoush , but the momentum remained firmly with the North Londoners. Despite late pressure from Antoine Semenyo and creative sparks from Rayan Cherki , the Arsenal defense remained resolute. Gabriel and Piero Hincapie made crucial interventions to protect the clean sheet. In front of a crowd of 58,056 , the final whistle confirmed a comprehensive and deserved victory for the Gunners, as they marched into the next round with a performance of genuine authority.
